"Mahatma Gandhi made his first major public appearance in India at the opening of the Banaras Hindu University (BHU) in February 1916. Look at the richly bedizened princes sitting on this dais. There is no salvation for India unless you strip yourselves of this jewellery and hold it in trust for your countrymen in India. There is no salvation for India as long as the vast millions of our peasants remain impoverished and forgotten. Our salvation can only come through the farmer; neither the lawyers, nor the doctors, nor the rich landlords are going to secure it.'"
